preserved_full_claims.thm-duflo-joseph-g-finite-endomorphisms-: Assume the Axiom of Choice. For every highest weight mu of a finite-dimensional complex semisimple Lie algebra, the action induces an algebra isomorphism $$U(g)/U(g)\ker\chi_\mu\ \xrightarrow{\sim}\ (\operatorname{End}_{\mathbb C}M(\mu))^{\mathrm{ad}\,g\text{-finite}}.$$ In particular Ann M(mu)=U(g)ker chi_mu. For every finite-dimensional E, dim Hom_g(M(mu),E tensor M(mu))=dim E_0, and the action identifies each finite adjoint isotypic multiplicity with that dimension.
preserved_full_claims.prop-base-change-freeness-and-specializa: Assume the Axiom of Choice. In the deformed family of [[def-the-deformed-category-o-family-and-its-specializations]] with $T$ a localization of $S=S(\mathfrak h)$ and $M,N\in\mathcal D_T(\lambda)$: (1) the canonical map $$U(\mathfrak g)\otimes_Z T\longrightarrow \big(\operatorname{End}_T(M_T(\lambda))\big)^{\mathfrak g\text{-finite}},\qquad u\otimes t\longmapsto\big(m\mapsto u\cdot m\cdot t\big),$$ is an isomorphism of $T$-algebras, the superscript denoting the $\mathfrak g$-finite part for the adjoint action $X\cdot f=X\circ f-f\circ X$, and $Z=Z(U(\mathfrak g))$ acting on $T$ through the published shifted Harish-Chandra isomorphism $\operatorname{HC}_\rho$ followed by evaluation at $\lambda+\rho+\epsilon$ on the universal parameter $\epsilon$; (2) $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathfrak g\otimes T}(E\otimes M_T(\lambda),F\otimes M_T(\lambda))$ is a free $T$-module of rank $\dim(E\otimes F^*)_0$ for finite-dimensional $E,F$, where the subscript denotes the zero weight space, and the natural base-change map $$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathfrak g\otimes T}(M,N)\otimes_T\kappa(\epsilon)\longrightarrow \operatorname{Hom}_{\mathfrak g\otimes\kappa(\epsilon)}(M\otimes_T\kappa(\epsilon),N\otimes_T\kappa(\epsilon))$$ is an isomorphism for every $\epsilon\in\operatorname{Spec} T$, with residue field $\kappa(\epsilon)$; (3) $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathfrak g\otimes T}(M,N)$ is locally free of finite rank over $T$; (4) if a $\mathfrak g\otimes R$-linear map of objects of $\mathcal D_R(\lambda)$ is an isomorphism on the special fiber at $0$, it is an isomorphism (Nakayama).
